dialogue.agent: Hello, how may I help you today?

dialogue.user: Hi! I’m looking for a high-end pair of shoes, ideally in the $500 to $5000 range. I’m curious what kind of options you have in that price bracket. Could you tell me about a couple of your top-rated choices? I also care quite a bit about the customer reviews—are there any that stand out for customer satisfaction?
dialogue.agent:

   - “It is a good looking shoe. These shoes are very comfortable and stylish. I am very pleased with my purchase.”
   - “Awesome shoe. Very comfortable.”
   - “Package came in superb immaculate condition. Thank you so much.”

The Air Jordan 9 GS “University Gold” is the youth sizing of Michael Jordan’s ninth signature shoe in a colorway that is based loosely on a popular look from 2010
The “University Gold” makes use of a similar shade of yellow as that of the “Citrus” Jordan 9 from July 2010
Both colorways feature a predominantly neutral design and employ subtle pops of orange or, in this case, yellow
The rest of the “University Gold” displays a synthetic black nubuck construction with a “diamond” perforation motif appearing along the medial and lateral sides of the shoe
A grey synthetic nubuck mudguard above the black midsole breaks up the look. Release date: January 30, 2021.
